threshold_note: IsolationForest.predict() derives its Normal/Anomaly decision directly from `contamination` (via the fitted offset_), so contamination is searched as the threshold gene instead of a separate manual score cutoff.
fitness_metric_note: Chosen over accuracy because of the 2.9% anomaly rate in this dataset (see V1 baseline): accuracy is trivially maximized by predicting Normal for everything. F1 on the Anomaly class balances precision/recall for the class of interest and matches the metric used to evaluate V1, so GA optimizes exactly what is reported.
